column7: A secret-scoped access-request approval whose secret was deleted (DeleteSecret or the DeleteProject cascade) between ApproveSecretAccessRequest's liveness check and its write committed approved, was never swept by closeApprovedSecretAccessRequests (#2797), and came back live on restore. UpdateAccessRequest now re-checks the secret with lockLiveParent after the write in the same transaction and rolls back. Postgres two-pool variants (pg-gated): TestApproveSecretAccessRequest_DeleteInApprovalWindow_Postgres, TestApproveSecretAccessRequest_DeleteSweep_AllOrderings_Postgres.
